最终 SQL：
```sql
SELECT T1.ref1
FROM trns AS T1
INNER JOIN acct AS T2 ON T1.ref1 = T2.accn_id
WHERE YEAR(T1.dt) = 1998
  AND T1.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND T1.amnt < (SELECT AVG(amnt) FROM trns WHERE YEAR(dt) = 1998)
```
